sources: Primary publisher/conference records, author projects, official repositories; no runtime reproduction during this survey.

papers.title: Learning contact-rich whole-body manipulation with example-guided reinforcement learning
papers.open_scope: Isaac Gym task/training/policy playback, robot assets and demonstrations; includes an example checkpoint.
papers.embodiment: Punyo compliant humanoid upper body, not a walking biped.
papers.evidence: Simulation training and physical upper-body hardware.
papers.method: Example-guided reinforcement learning using motion demonstrations and rich body contact.
papers.application: Bulky object handling using arms and torso.
papers.boundary: Transfer to full-body G1 requires balance and morphology adaptation; compliance and tactile hardware are important.

papers.title: Hierarchical generative modelling for autonomous robots
papers.open_scope: High/mid/low-level controller implementations, training instructions and pretrained policy/asset download links.
papers.evidence: Physics simulation; paper explicitly leaves real-world transfer for subsequent sim-to-real work.
papers.method: Hierarchical control with motion-capture imitation in locomotion; SAC/double-Q learning and low-level control, not diffusion generation.
papers.application: Box transport, button/door interaction and long-horizon navigation-operation chains.
papers.boundary: Not a physical robot deployment result; not an implementation of our proposed world-model plus PPO.

papers.title: InterMimic: Towards Universal Whole-Body Control for Physics-Based Human-Object Interactions
papers.open_scope: Isaac Gym teacher/student training, distillation/inference/evaluation, checkpoints and data links; later repository includes G1 simulation and Isaac Lab replay/inference.
papers.embodiment: Paper primarily SMPL-X simulated humans; current repository also has Unitree G1 simulation.
papers.evidence: Physics simulation; do not infer real G1 hardware transfer from repository support.
papers.method: Contact-aware imitation, teacher-student training and physically corrected demonstration trajectories.
papers.application: Whole-body human-object interaction, contact-rich lifting/pushing and physical motion-data refinement.
papers.boundary: Isaac Lab replay/inference support is not evidence of a fully equivalent Lab training port.

papers.title: InterAct: Advancing Large-Scale Versatile 3D Human-Object Interaction Generation
papers.open_scope: HOI data processing/correction, text-conditioned interaction training/evaluation/inference, checkpoints and conversion to simulation assets.
papers.embodiment: Human-object motion generation/dataset, not a physical humanoid robot controller.
papers.evidence: Generative modeling and data benchmark; physical execution needs a tracking controller.
papers.method: Text-conditioned human-object motion generation and contact-guided data correction.
papers.application: Scene/object-conditioned demonstrations for household and logistics interactions.
papers.boundary: Code and datasets/models may have different licenses; generated motion quality does not establish robot task success.

papers.title: HumanPlus: Humanoid Shadowing and Imitation from Humans
papers.open_scope: HST tracking training, HIT visual imitation learning and hardware deployment code; unified license not confirmed.
papers.embodiment: Customized 33-DoF physical biped humanoid, not G1.
papers.method: PPO human-motion tracking plus supervised visual behavior cloning from teleoperated demonstrations.
papers.application: Warehouse object transfer, folding, rearranging objects and human interaction.
papers.boundary: Task-level vision and demonstrations are additional to motion tracking; not all project demos are autonomous.

papers.title: OmniH2O: Universal and Dexterous Human-to-Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation and Learning
papers.open_scope: Retargeting, PPO teacher/student training and H1 hardware code; high-level Diffusion Policy refers to external implementations. CC-BY-NC-4.0.
papers.embodiment: Physical Unitree H1 EDU with dexterous hands.
papers.method: Privileged motion-tracking teacher and deployable distilled student; supports teleoperation, text-generated references and task-level imitation.
papers.application: Whole-body remote operation, object handling and human interaction.
papers.boundary: H1 implementation requires G1 adaptation; released dataset tasks do not imply every task has an autonomous evaluation.

papers.title: HOVER: Versatile Neural Whole-Body Controller for Humanoid Robots
papers.open_scope: Isaac Lab tracking/oracle/student training, retargeting, MuJoCo sim-to-sim and H1 deployment; Apache-2.0; motion data requires separate access.
papers.embodiment: Physical Unitree H1; current deployment wrapper targets H1.
papers.method: RL full-body imitation oracle distilled with command masks and DAgger to a multi-mode controller.
papers.application: Unified control of locomotion velocity, hand targets, partial joints and full-body references.
papers.boundary: Control framework rather than autonomous household manipulation; G1 implementation must be separately validated.

papers.title: HOMIE: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Isomorphic Exoskeleton Cockpit
papers.open_scope: HomieRL, hardware designs/firmware and G1 deployment; CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.
papers.embodiment: Physical Unitree G1 with Dex3 hands.
papers.method: Motion-prior-free lower-body RL and exoskeleton teleoperation; collected demonstrations support subsequent imitation learning.
papers.application: Low/high shelf transfer, squat pick, handover and opening an oven.
papers.boundary: Complex demonstrations mostly teleoperated; lower-body control is not human motion imitation; originally Isaac Gym.

papers.title: TWIST: Teleoperated Whole-Body Imitation System
papers.open_scope: Motion data, teacher/student training, pretrained tracker, sim-to-sim and sim-to-real scripts; MIT.
papers.embodiment: Physical 29-DoF Unitree G1; Booster T1 extension is sim-to-sim.
papers.method: PPO teacher tracks retargeted motion; deployable current-reference student trained with RL and BC, with end-effector disturbances.
papers.application: Whole-body teleoperation, floor box lifting, hand-foot coordination and human handover.
papers.boundary: Operator-driven object tasks are not evidence of autonomous diffusion-conditioned completion; originally Isaac Gym.

papers.title: Sim-to-Real Learning for Humanoid Box Loco-Manipulation
papers.open_scope: No official public training/deployment repository verified in this search.
papers.method: PPO and domain randomization for separately trained box handling behaviors; not human demonstration imitation.
papers.application: Approach, pick up, carry and place boxes.
papers.boundary: Human-controlled skill switching and known object parameters; application/reward reference rather than direct imitation baseline.

papers.title: ASAP: Aligning Simulation and Real-World Physics for Learning Agile Humanoid Whole-Body Skills
papers.open_scope: Phase-based tracking, retargeting, delta-action learning, fine-tuning, MuJoCo and Unitree deployment.
papers.method: PPO motion tracking followed by target-dynamics residual-action alignment and fine-tuning.
papers.application: Jumping, single-leg balance/hopping and dance or agile motion execution.
papers.boundary: Mostly single-motion phase policies, not arbitrary-reference universal tracking; does not establish autonomous complex-terrain navigation.

papers.title: Learning Humanoid Standing-up Control across Diverse Postures
papers.open_scope: Isaac Gym PPO training/evaluation and terrain configurations; some joint-training combinations remain incomplete.
papers.method: Reference-free PPO, multiple critics and assistance/action-scale curricula.
papers.application: Fall recovery and standing up from diverse surfaces/postures.
papers.boundary: A complementary recovery branch, not imitation learning; integration into a motion-tracking controller is not demonstrated.

papers.title: SONIC: Supersizing motion tracking for natural humanoid whole-body control
papers.open_scope: Isaac Lab PPO training/fine-tuning/evaluation, model checkpoints, ONNX/C++ deployment, teleoperation and MuJoCo; Apache-2.0 code and NVIDIA Open Model License weights.
papers.method: Large-scale motion imitation with a common control token interface for human, robot and hybrid references.
papers.application: Natural whole-body expression, low posture locomotion, VR/video teleoperation and VLA-driven manipulation.
papers.boundary: Public data is a subset of paper data; full-scale training uses extensive compute; general motion tracking does not establish arbitrary-terrain or long-term task reliability.

papers.title: ZEST: Zero-shot embodied skill transfer for athletic robot control
papers.open_scope: No official public training/deployment repository verified as of 2026-10-08.
papers.embodiment: Physical Atlas, G1 and Spot; framework adapted per embodiment.
papers.method: Retargeted demonstrations and Isaac Lab asymmetric PPO residual tracking with difficult-segment sampling and assistance curricula.
papers.application: Athletic and multi-contact movements from motion capture/video/animation.
papers.boundary: Not a single unchanged policy across all robots; assumes sufficiently modeled robots and mainly flat non-slippery ground.

papers.title: Humanoid Parkour Learning
papers.open_scope: No official humanoid implementation verified; quadruped predecessor code is not this implementation.
papers.embodiment: Physical Unitree H1 with depth perception.
papers.method: Motion-prior-free PPO terrain curriculum and DAgger perception distillation.
papers.application: Complex-terrain navigation, steps, gaps, slopes and obstacle traversal.
papers.boundary: Adjacent non-imitation method; terrain generalization and G1 adaptation require separate tests.

papers.title: Let Humanoids Hike! Integrative Skill Development on Complex Trails
papers.open_scope: Official project still says Code Coming Soon.
papers.embodiment: Simulated H1 and other humanoid forms.
papers.method: Visual hierarchical navigation/control and privileged-teacher distillation; no human-motion prior.
papers.application: Complex-trail navigation benchmark and perception-conditioned control.
papers.boundary: Simulation-only evidence, not a physical outdoor hiking result or directly available imitation code.
